READ: The Manila Police District has released a list of road closures and re-routing of vehicles in the city on Sunday, Nov. 30, in preparation for another wave of anti-corruption protests.

Another "Baha sa Luneta" rally will be staged at the Luneta Park in Manila, while the second "Trillion Peso March" is at the EDSA People Power Monument in Quezon City.

📸 MPD PIO/Facebook
